provenance.rule: Conclusions preserve the reviewed Git evidence and do not treat a future ProvisioningBoundary as proof.

account_subject_identity.impact: Duplicate and same-subject distinct-account conflict detection cannot be made authoritative; per-subject serialization and idempotency cannot be frozen.

states.meaning: Mint/reservation intent; not an account fact.
Candidate bound to authenticated root/provisioning evidence; still not genuine.
Only after the genesis decision authority atomically commits one genuine genesis record.

account_id_state_machine.genuine_at: successful durable account-genesis commit by the genuine genesis decision authority

A_ACCOUNT_AUTHORITY_PRE_ADMISSION_RESERV.abandoned_reuse: FORBIDDEN unless canonically released; release semantics absent
A_ACCOUNT_AUTHORITY_PRE_ADMISSION_RESERV.circularity: could be non-circular only with independent root proof; not proven

B_EXTERNAL_PROVISIONING_AUTHORITY_MINTS_.genuine_at: account genesis commit, never issuance alone
B_EXTERNAL_PROVISIONING_AUTHORITY_MINTS_.circularity: issuer must pre-exist account; not proven

C_ATOMIC_ISSUER_AND_ACCOUNT_AUTHORITY_PR.expires: evidence must be valid at commit; reservation expiry NOT_FROZEN
C_ATOMIC_ISSUER_AND_ACCOUNT_AUTHORITY_PR.circularity: participants and independent pre-account root must be frozen; absent

E_DESIGN_BLOCKED.genuine_at: frozen only as genesis commit boundary; authority/protocol absent

selected_or_blocked_mint_model.reason: No canonical owner, subject identity, independent root authority, or durable handoff/atomic protocol exists.

ACCOUNT_FIRST.M03_compatibility: Conceptually preserves M0.3 as consumer, but no canonical contract proves membership may be issued after genesis; ordering cannot be selected without upstream contract work.
ACCOUNT_FIRST.root_proof_relationship_to_later_device_: NOT_FROZEN: the root proof is not assumed to be the same object or authority as the later first-device ProvisioningMembershipBinding.

ATOMIC_ACCOUNT_PLUS_FIRST_DEVICE.required_single_decision: account genesis + first DeviceInstallation admission/provisioning binding
ATOMIC_ACCOUNT_PLUS_FIRST_DEVICE.root_evidence_and_device_membership_part: Allowed only if ownership and relationship are explicitly frozen; no equivalence is implied and FirstRunBootstrapAuthority scope is not expanded.

selected_or_blocked_ordering_model.reason: Child cardinality and the joint M0.3 claim prove neither ACCOUNT_FIRST nor an atomic committer.

permitted_edges: independent pre-account root authority -> root proof
forbidden_edges: genuine CryptoHunterAccount -> root proof for that same account
account-scoped post-genesis authority -> root proof for that same account
current_missing_edges: independent pre-account root authority -> root proof

circularity.cycle_detection: A root proof requiring genuine acct_A or an authority scoped by acct_A forms a cycle and MUST be rejected.

genesis_decision_authority.decision: Only a genuine, independently rooted account-genesis authority may decide that genesis exists.

genesis_record_semantics.reason: Root authority, authenticator, freshness anchor, and their durable identifiers are not owned.
genesis_record_semantics.expiry: Evidence must be valid at genesis commit; later expiry does not erase immutable history.
genesis_record_semantics.restart_proof: Must durably authenticate why this exact genesis was accepted without caller, M0.11 projection, or public hash trust.

serialization.authority_global: possible safety fallback but no authority exists and it cannot identify logical duplicates
serialization.per_account_id_reservation: required for at-most-one genesis per ID but insufficient for acct_A/acct_B of one subject
serialization.per_provisioning_subject_customer: required for same-subject duplicate exclusion but BLOCKED because stable subject key is NOT_FOUND
serialization.per_external_issuer_subject: possible only after canonical issuer and stable subject are frozen

idempotency.requirement: A stable authority-issued identity must map every exact retry to the same committed genesis result.

same_account.invariant: at most one account genesis commit

distinct_account_same_subject.rule: Must not silently create two accounts for the same external subject.

concurrency.distinct_genuine_subjects: Both may potentially be valid only when independently authenticated stable subject bindings differ.

reservation_crash_recovery.release: Only an authenticated durable authority abort/release decision; semantics NOT_FROZEN
reservation_crash_recovery.restart: Fail closed and recover the same reservation; never silently remint.

genesis_crash_recovery.scenario: authority record written; crash before final acknowledgement
genesis_crash_recovery.mechanism: Requires durable authority-issued idempotency identity and authenticated committed head; DESIGN_BLOCKED

root_evidence_device_membership_relation.rule: Neither equivalence nor required separation may be inferred until ownership, timing, and the selected genesis model are frozen.

multi_device_after_genesis.invariant: dev_2, dev_3, ... must resolve existing genuine acct_A and must NEVER trigger account genesis.

authentication_requirements.verification_authority: must be independent from caller and account being created

freshness_requirements.post_commit_expiry: does not erase immutable genesis history
freshness_requirements.binding: exact proof/decision generation and commit must be durably bound

impact_on_M03.role: consumer of already-established account identity only (if ACCOUNT_FIRST is later selected)
impact_on_M03.M03_CONTRACT_MIGRATION_REQUIRED: would apply if a later selected atomic model expands M0.3 ownership

impact_on_AccountAuthority_design.reason: Conceptual invariants do not supply subject identity, root owner, mint protocol, serialization, authentication, or rollback anchor.

impact_on_Workspace.reason: Workspace intrinsic semantics remain independently unfrozen.

result.intrinsic_semantic_status: DESIGN_BLOCKED: subject identity, root owner, mint/reservation owner and protocol, ordering/atomicity, serialization, idempotency, authentication and rollback anchor remain unresolved
